anirākatajjhāna.p: [Anirākata+jhāna] (ti) CL=8 The person who has the intense concentration of mind which should not take out outside - disappear -

anirāmagandha.p: [Na+nirāmagandha(=ni+āma+gandha)] (ti) CL=8 Not meaning that without smell of raw flesh poultry, meat, fish, The person who has the smell of raw flesh poultry, meat, fish
